Cc: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@cloudtechsummit.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Booth riser & primary aisle visibility — follow up

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for confirming booth E12 (corner pod) for CloudTech. A couple of items to flag before we finalize your floorplan:

- We have a temporary riser mounting restriction on the primary aisle for pods adjacent to the main corridor. Riser height is limited to 18" unless we get an exception.
- For corner pods we can grant a 24" riser if you commit to a 3-sided graphic treatment and keep demo tables recessed 12" from the aisle.

Attached is a rough riser render and the booth adjacency rules. If Redwood wants the 24" riser, we need approval from venue engineering by 11/08 to get permits and crane scheduling.

Would you like us to submit the exception, or stick with the 18" standard?

Best,
Samir
ExpoOps — Senior Site Planner

Attachments: Riser_Render_v2.pdf, Venue_Adjacency_Rules.pdf
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@expoops.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Booth riser & primary aisle visibility — follow up

Thanks Samir — looping in Marissa (events lead) and Karthik (build ops). Marissa, Karthik: two questions for you both before I give the go-ahead on the 24" riser exception request:

1) Can the demo desks be set back 12" from the front edge without impacting the visitor flow? We have a new demo with two stations that need 30" clear at the front.
2) If we do 24" riser + 3-sided graphics, what are the incremental print costs and lead times? PrintWorks quoted us tight windows before.

If we commit to the exception we need to approve visuals and crate labels for the riser panels (cause the riser is shipped in separate crates). Samir — please start the permit request if we confirm.

Laura Bennett
Head of Events, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Quote — riser graphics / three-sided wrap (lead times & freight)

Hi team,

Thanks for the ping. Summary of options based on 24" riser wrap (3-sided):

A) Economy: 3-sided printed vinyl wrap, 4-6 day production, $1,250 (materials + print), ships on pallet.
B) Premium: Dye-sublimated fabric panels with edge-sewn finish, 8-10 day production, $2,100, ships in soft crate + foam.

Notes: both include velcro-compatible backing for quick install. If you need crate labeling and manifesting per Apex Logistics instructions, add $95 for labels and $60 for manifest formatting (we can fill your Crate_Label_Specs.xlsx template).

I've attached the formal PDF quote. Let me know which option you want to book; cutoff for guaranteed arrival before exhibitor move-in is 11/18 (we can expedite but additional 2-3 day fee applies).

Best,
Renee Cole
Account Manager — PrintWorks Co.

Subject: Re: Tiered booth visibility & riser signage — decision checklist

Quick notes after review with Ops:

- Demo desk setback: doable. We'll reduce demo table depth by 4" and move AV rack under riser on the side to preserve 30" clear at front.
- Print option: choose Premium (dye-sublimated) for cleaner photos and less glare on camera. Approve the $2,100 line + $95 crate label fee.
- Crate labels: Logan, please use the attached Crate_Label_Specs.xlsx fields (crate id, destination dock window, fragile flag, riser-panel-index). Apex needs crate manifest by 11/20.
- Permit timing: Samir, please run the permit with venue engineering ASAP. We need permit signed by 11/08 to keep the 24" option.

Marissa
Senior Events Manager
